13 NONCLINICAL TOXICOLOGY Carcinogenesis studies were conducted in mice and rats.
14 CLINICAL STUDIES 14.1 Rheumatoid Arthritis The efficacy and safety of RINVOQ were
assessed in five Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, controlled multicenter studies in
subjects with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis. Study M13-545
(SELECT-COMPARE) was a randomized, double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled study in
1629 subjects. Study M14-465 (SELECT-NEXT) was a randomized, double-blind study in 661
subjects who had an inadequate response to conventional synthetic DMARDs. Study M13-549
(SELECT-MONOTHERAPY) evaluated 648 subjects. Study M13-542 (SELECT-EARLY) enrolled
methotrexate-naive subjects. Study M14-653 (SELECT-BEYOND) enrolled subjects with an
inadequate response to biologic DMARDs. The primary endpoint in each study was the
proportion of subjects achieving an ACR20 response at Week 12.
16 HOW SUPPLIED/STORAGE AND HANDLING RINVOQ extended-release tablets are supplied as
purple biconvex tablets.
